checkin_discount_check.name: checkin_discount_check
checkin_discount_check.value: ("checkin"."discount_id" is null and "checkin"."discount_name" is null and "checkin"."discount_amount" is null and "checkin"."referrer_name" is null) or ("checkin"."discount_id" is not null and "checkin"."discount_name" is not null and "checkin"."discount_amount" is not null)

threads_account_connection_consistency.name: threads_account_connection_consistency
threads_account_connection_consistency.value:
("threads_account"."connection_status" = 'not_connected' AND "threads_account"."threads_user_id" IS NULL AND "threads_account"."username" IS NULL)
        OR ("threads_account"."connection_status" <> 'not_connected' AND "threads_account"."threads_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "threads_account"."username" IS NOT NULL)

threads_account_post_kind_length_range.name: threads_account_post_kind_length_range
threads_account_post_kind_length_range.value: "threads_account"."short_length" BETWEEN 10 AND "threads_account"."post_length_target" AND "threads_account"."medium_length" BETWEEN 10 AND "threads_account"."post_length_target" AND "threads_account"."long_length" BETWEEN 10 AND "threads_account"."post_length_target"

threads_account_post_kind_ratio_range.name: threads_account_post_kind_ratio_range
threads_account_post_kind_ratio_range.value: "threads_account"."short_ratio" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "threads_account"."medium_ratio" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "threads_account"."long_ratio" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "threads_account"."short_ratio" + "threads_account"."medium_ratio" + "threads_account"."long_ratio" = 100

threads_deletion_request_completed.name: threads_deletion_request_completed
threads_deletion_request_completed.value:
("threads_deletion_request"."status" = 'completed') = ("threads_deletion_request"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("threads_deletion_request"."status" <> 'completed' OR "threads_deletion_request"."threads_user_id" IS NULL)

threads_post_draft_blocked_state.name: threads_post_draft_blocked_state
threads_post_draft_blocked_state.value:
("threads_post_draft"."blocked_at" IS NULL AND "threads_post_draft"."blocked_reason" IS NULL AND "threads_post_draft"."blocked_words" IS NULL)
        OR ("threads_post_draft"."status" = 'needs_review' AND "threads_post_draft"."blocked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "threads_post_draft"."blocked_reason" IS NOT NULL)

threads_post_draft_threads_media_state.name: threads_post_draft_threads_media_state
threads_post_draft_threads_media_state.value: ("threads_post_draft"."threads_media_id" IS NULL AND "threads_post_draft"."threads_permalink" IS NULL) OR "threads_post_draft"."status" = 'published'

threads_post_draft_reject_reasons_valid.name: threads_post_draft_reject_reasons_valid
threads_post_draft_reject_reasons_valid.value:
"threads_post_draft"."reject_reasons" IS NULL OR (cardinality("threads_post_draft"."reject_reasons") >= 1
        AND array_position("threads_post_draft"."reject_reasons", NULL) IS NULL
        AND "threads_post_draft"."reject_reasons" <@ ARRAY['similar', 'tone', 'thin', 'inaccurate', 'too_promotional', 'policy']::text[])

threads_post_draft_review_state_v2.name: threads_post_draft_review_state_v2
threads_post_draft_review_state_v2.value:
("threads_post_draft"."status" = 'needs_review' AND "threads_post_draft"."reviewed_at" IS NULL AND "threads_post_draft"."reject_reasons" IS NULL AND "threads_post_draft"."reject_note" IS NULL
          AND "threads_post_draft"."prioritized_at" IS NULL AND "threads_post_draft"."carryover_attempt_id" IS NULL
          AND "threads_post_draft"."published_at" IS NULL AND "threads_post_draft"."publish_failed_at" IS NULL AND "threads_post_draft"."publish_error" IS NULL)
        OR ("threads_post_draft"."status" IN ('approved', 'publishing') AND "threads_post_draft"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "threads_post_draft"."reject_reasons" IS NULL AND "threads_post_draft"."reject_note" IS NULL
          AND "threads_post_draft"."published_at" IS NULL AND "threads_post_draft"."publish_failed_at" IS NULL AND "threads_post_draft"."publish_error" IS NULL)
        OR ("threads_post_draft"."status" = 'rejected' AND "threads_post_draft"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND (coalesce(cardinality("threads_post_draft"."reject_reasons"), 0) >= 1 OR coalesce(btrim("threads_post_draft"."reject_note"), '') <> '')
          AND "threads_post_draft"."prioritized_at" IS NULL AND "threads_post_draft"."carryover_attempt_id" IS NULL
          AND "threads_post_draft"."published_at" IS NULL AND "threads_post_draft"."publish_failed_at" IS NULL AND "threads_post_draft"."publish_error" IS NULL)
        OR ("threads_post_draft"."status" = 'published' AND "threads_post_draft"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "threads_post_draft"."reject_reasons" IS NULL AND "threads_post_draft"."reject_note" IS NULL
          AND "threads_post_draft"."prioritized_at" IS NULL AND "threads_post_draft"."carryover_attempt_id" IS NULL
          AND "threads_post_draft"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "threads_post_draft"."publish_failed_at" IS NULL AND "threads_post_draft"."publish_error" IS NULL)
        OR ("threads_post_draft"."status" = 'publish_failed' AND "threads_post_draft"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "threads_post_draft"."reject_reasons" IS NULL AND "threads_post_draft"."reject_note" IS NULL
          AND "threads_post_draft"."prioritized_at" IS NULL AND "threads_post_draft"."carryover_attempt_id" IS NULL
          AND "threads_post_draft"."published_at" IS NULL AND "threads_post_draft"."publish_failed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "threads_post_draft"."publish_error" IS NOT NULL)

threads_post_mention_when.name: threads_post_mention_when
threads_post_mention_when.value: "threads_post_mention"."delay_minutes" IS NOT NULL OR "threads_post_mention"."send_after" IS NOT NULL

threads_post_metric_unmeasurable_reason.name: threads_post_metric_unmeasurable_reason
threads_post_metric_unmeasurable_reason.value:
("threads_post_metric"."state" = 'unmeasurable') = ("threads_post_metric"."unmeasurable_reason" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("threads_post_metric"."unmeasurable_reason" IS NULL OR "threads_post_metric"."unmeasurable_reason" in ('not_found', 'no_media_id'))

threads_post_metric_judgment.name: threads_post_metric_judgment
threads_post_metric_judgment.value:
"threads_post_metric"."judgment" IS NULL OR ("threads_post_metric"."judgment" in ('good', 'normal', 'poor')
        AND "threads_post_metric"."state" IN ('confirmed', 'late_confirmed') AND "threads_post_metric"."judgment_ratio" IS NOT NULL AND "threads_post_metric"."judgment_baseline" > 0)

threads_post_metric_counts_nonnegative.name: threads_post_metric_counts_nonnegative
threads_post_metric_counts_nonnegative.value:
coalesce("threads_post_metric"."views", 0) >= 0 AND coalesce("threads_post_metric"."likes", 0) >= 0 AND coalesce("threads_post_metric"."replies", 0) >= 0
        AND coalesce("threads_post_metric"."reposts", 0) >= 0 AND coalesce("threads_post_metric"."quotes", 0) >= 0 AND coalesce("threads_post_metric"."shares", 0) >= 0

threads_publish_attempt_skip_state.name: threads_publish_attempt_skip_state
threads_publish_attempt_skip_state.value:
("threads_publish_attempt"."state" = 'skipped' AND "threads_publish_attempt"."skip_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "threads_publish_attempt"."draft_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("threads_publish_attempt"."state" <> 'skipped' AND "threads_publish_attempt"."skip_reason" IS NULL)

threads_publish_attempt_pending_has_draf.name: threads_publish_attempt_pending_has_draft
threads_publish_attempt_pending_has_draf.value: "threads_publish_attempt"."state" NOT IN ('in_progress', 'retry_wait') OR "threads_publish_attempt"."draft_id" IS NOT NULL
